MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Part 5: Perception of Coordination Level. Nine-item self-report Likert subscale (1=Strongly Disagree .. 7=Strongly Agree), administered post-experiment. From the Duorhythm questionnaire.

item_01.Description: My partner and I felt like a single unit during the game.

item_02.Description: Coordination between my partner and I felt seamless.

item_03.Description: Both my partner and I contributed equally to our performance.

item_04.Description: The level of coordination achieved with my partner met or exceeded my expectations.

item_05.Description: We maintained a steady coordination level from start to finish.

item_06.Description: My partner and I were able to enhance our coordination as the game progressed.

item_07.Description: We handled high-pressure or challenging moments in the game without losing our coordination.

item_08.Description: When we faced disruptions, my partner and I swiftly regained our coordinated rhythm.

item_09.Description: I trust in our combined ability to coordinate successfully in any game scenario.
